prompts.phrase: Bom dia! Em que posso ajudá-lo?
prompts.english: Good morning! How can I help you?
prompts.context: Shop or office worker greeting you in the morning
prompts.yourResponse: Bom dia! Estava à procura de...
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Good morning! I was looking for...

prompts.phrase: Boa tarde! Está tudo bem?
prompts.english: Good afternoon! Is everything well?
prompts.context: A friendly local greeting you in the afternoon
prompts.yourResponse: Boa tarde! Tudo bem, obrigado. E o senhor?
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Good afternoon! All good, thanks. And yourself?

prompts.phrase: Boa noite! Bem-vindo a Portugal.
prompts.english: Good evening! Welcome to Portugal.
prompts.context: Hotel or airport staff greeting you on arrival
prompts.yourResponse: Boa noite! Obrigado, estou muito contente por estar cá.
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Good evening! Thank you, I'm very happy to be here.

prompts.phrase: Até logo! Tenha um bom dia.
prompts.english: Goodbye! Have a good day.
prompts.context: Shopkeeper or local saying goodbye
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Likewise! See you later.

prompts.phrase: Até amanhã!
prompts.english: See you tomorrow!
prompts.context: Someone you'll be seeing again the next day
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: See you tomorrow! Good night.

prompts.phrase: Cuide-se!
prompts.english: Take care!
prompts.context: Friendly parting from a local or shopkeeper
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Thanks! You too.

prompts.phrase: Como está? Tudo bem?
prompts.english: How are you? Everything good?
prompts.context: A friendly local or regular check-in
prompts.yourResponse: Tudo bem, obrigado. E o senhor?
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: All good, thanks. And yourself?

prompts.phrase: Prazer em conhecê-lo!
prompts.english: Nice to meet you!
prompts.context: Being introduced to someone for the first time
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: The pleasure is mine!

prompts.phrase: Fala português?
prompts.english: Do you speak Portuguese?
prompts.context: A local asking if you speak the language
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: No, I speak very little Portuguese.

prompts.phrase: Não se preocupe, consigo falar um pouco de inglês.
prompts.english: Don't worry, I can speak a little English.
prompts.context: A helpful local offering to switch languages
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Thank you.

prompts.phrase: Com licença, posso passar?
prompts.english: Excuse me, can I get past?
prompts.context: Someone trying to get through a crowded space
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Of course, go ahead.

prompts.phrase: Desculpe o incómodo.
prompts.english: Sorry to bother you.
prompts.context: Someone approaching you to ask for help or directions
prompts.yourResponse: Sem problema, mas não falo português.
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: No problem, but I don't speak Portuguese.

prompts.phrase: De nada! Não tem de quê.
prompts.english: You're welcome! Don't mention it.
prompts.context: After you thank someone for their help
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: See you later!

prompts.phrase: Boa sorte!
prompts.english: Good luck!
prompts.context: Someone wishing you well before something important
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Thanks! I'll need it.

prompts.phrase: Tenha um bom fim de semana!
prompts.english: Have a good weekend!
prompts.context: End-of-week farewell from a local or shopkeeper
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Likewise! Have a good weekend!

prompts.phrase: Não falo inglês.
prompts.english: No, I don't speak English.
prompts.context: Local responding that they don't speak English
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Ok, I'll try!

prompts.phrase: Têm reserva?
prompts.english: Do you have a reservation?
prompts.context: Hostess asking if you have a reservation when walking in
prompts.yourResponse: Não temos reserva. Têm mesa para quatro pessoas?
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: We don't have a reservation. Do you have a table for four?

prompts.phrase: A mesa está reservada em nome de quem?
prompts.english: What name is the reservation under?
prompts.context: Hostess checking your reservation
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: It's under the name [name].

prompts.phrase: Para beber?
prompts.english: To drink?
prompts.context: Waiter asking for your drink order
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Water, please.

prompts.phrase: Com gás ou sem gás?
prompts.english: Sparkling or still?
prompts.context: Waiter following up on your water order
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Still, please.

prompts.phrase: Já escolheram o que vão querer?
prompts.english: Have you decided what you'll have?
prompts.context: Waiter taking your order
prompts.yourResponse: Ainda não. Pode dar-nos mais um minuto?
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Not yet. Can you give us another minute?

prompts.phrase: Hoje temos bacalhau à brás como sugestão do chef.
prompts.english: Today we have bacalhau à brás as the chef's suggestion.
prompts.context: Waiter presenting the daily special
prompts.yourResponse: Interessante. Pode dar-nos um momento para decidir?
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Interesting. Can you give us a moment to decide?

prompts.phrase: Está tudo bem com a refeição?
prompts.english: Is everything alright with your meal?
prompts.context: Waiter checking in mid-meal
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Yes, it's great, thanks.

prompts.phrase: Deseja sobremesa ou café?
prompts.english: Would you like dessert or coffee?
prompts.context: Waiter after the main course
prompts.yourResponse: Só uma meia de leite, por favor.
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Just a coffee with milk, please.

prompts.phrase: Pode trazer a conta, por favor?
prompts.english: Can you bring the bill, please?
prompts.context: You proactively asking for the bill — in Portugal waiters won't bring it until you ask
prompts.yourResponse: Pode trazer a conta, por favor?
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Can you bring the bill, please?

prompts.phrase: Querem a conta juntos ou separada?
prompts.english: Do you want the bill together or split?
prompts.context: Waiter at the end of the meal
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Together is fine, thanks.

prompts.phrase: Tem cartão de fidelidade?
prompts.english: Do you have a loyalty card?
prompts.context: Cashier asking at checkout — very common at Pingo Doce and other chains
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: I don't have one, thanks.

prompts.phrase: Quer saco?
prompts.english: Do you want a bag?
prompts.context: Cashier asking about bags — bags cost €0.10–€0.20 by law
prompts.yourResponse: Sim, um saco, se faz favor.
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Yes, one bag please.

prompts.phrase: Quer fatura?
prompts.english: Do you want a receipt/invoice?
prompts.context: Cashier asking if you want a fiscal receipt — part of Portugal's national tax lottery system
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Yes, but I don't have a NIF.

prompts.phrase: Tem moedas?
prompts.english: Do you have coins?
prompts.context: Cashier asking if you have exact change — cash culture is still strong in Portugal
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: I don't, sorry.

prompts.phrase: Pode passar o cartão.
prompts.english: You can tap or swipe your card.
prompts.context: Cashier directing you to pay by card
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Can I pay contactless?

prompts.phrase: Esta caixa está fechada.
prompts.english: This checkout is closed.
prompts.context: Cashier or sign indicating a register is not open
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Oh, sorry. Which one is open?

prompts.phrase: Precisa de ajuda?
prompts.english: Do you need help?
prompts.context: Store employee approaching you on the shop floor
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Just looking, thanks.

prompts.phrase: Esta fruta está em promoção até ao fim da semana.
prompts.english: This fruit is on offer until the end of the week.
prompts.context: Store employee pointing out a deal
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Then I'll take a kilo.

prompts.phrase: Esse produto não está disponível neste momento.
prompts.english: That product is currently out of stock.
prompts.context: Store employee about an unavailable item
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: When do you expect to have more?

prompts.phrase: São cinquenta euros, por favor.
prompts.english: That's fifty euros, please.
prompts.context: Cashier stating your total
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Here you go.

prompts.phrase: O próximo autocarro demora cerca de vinte minutos.
prompts.english: The next bus is about twenty minutes away.
prompts.context: Passenger at the bus stop
prompts.yourResponse: Obrigado. Há algum metro por perto?
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Thanks. Is there a metro nearby?

prompts.phrase: Tem de validar o passe antes de entrar na carruagem.
prompts.english: You need to validate your pass before boarding the carriage.
prompts.context: Metro staff warning you
prompts.yourResponse: Ah, desculpe. Onde é que valido?
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Oh, sorry. Where do I validate?

prompts.phrase: Esta paragem fica mesmo ao pé do Castelo de São Jorge.
prompts.english: This stop is right next to Castelo de São Jorge.
prompts.context: Bus driver or fellow passenger informing you
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Perfect, I'll get off here then. Thanks.

prompts.phrase: O metro está parado por avaria na linha verde.
prompts.english: The metro has stopped due to a breakdown on the green line.
prompts.context: PA announcement at the metro station
prompts.yourResponse: Quanto tempo vai demorar a retomar?
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: How long until it starts again?

prompts.phrase: Vire à esquerda no segundo semáforo e siga em frente.
prompts.english: Turn left at the second traffic lights and carry on straight.
prompts.context: Pedestrian giving you directions
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Many thanks. Is it far from here?

prompts.phrase: Há obras na Avenida da Liberdade, é melhor desviar.
prompts.english: There are roadworks on Avenida da Liberdade, better to go around.
prompts.context: Taxi driver warning about road conditions
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: So what's the best way to go?

prompts.phrase: O elétrico 28 passa aqui de dez em dez minutos.
prompts.english: Tram 28 comes here every ten minutes.
prompts.context: Local giving you transport advice
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Great, I'll wait then. Thanks.

prompts.phrase: O check-in é a partir das três da tarde.
prompts.english: Check-in is from three in the afternoon.
prompts.context: Host explaining arrival time
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Can we drop off our luggage early?

prompts.phrase: As chaves ficam na caixa de segurança junto à porta.
prompts.english: The keys are in the lockbox next to the door.
prompts.context: Host giving access instructions
prompts.yourResponse: Qual é o código da caixa?
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: What's the code for the lockbox?

prompts.phrase: A palavra-passe do Wi-Fi está num papel em cima da mesa.
prompts.english: The Wi-Fi password is on a piece of paper on the table.
prompts.context: Host providing connectivity details
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Thanks. Does it have Netflix?

prompts.phrase: O lixo separa-se neste contentor verde aqui fora.
prompts.english: The rubbish is sorted in this green bin outside.
prompts.context: Host explaining waste separation
prompts.yourResponse: Está bem. E o papel vai para o contentor azul?
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: OK. And paper goes in the blue bin?

prompts.phrase: Se precisar de toalhas extra, mande-me uma mensagem.
prompts.english: If you need extra towels, send me a message.
prompts.context: Host explaining how to request things
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Perfect. Thanks for your hospitality.

prompts.phrase: O aquecimento liga-se com o botão ao lado da janela.
prompts.english: The heating is turned on with the button next to the window.
prompts.context: Host showing you how to use the heating
prompts.yourResponse: Obrigado. E funciona a gás ou elétrico?
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Thanks. Is it gas or electric?

prompts.phrase: O check-out tem de ser antes das onze da manhã.
prompts.english: Check-out must be before eleven in the morning.
prompts.context: Host reminding you of departure time
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Yes, we'll be out before then. Thanks.

prompts.phrase: Quer experimentar no provador?
prompts.english: Would you like to try it on in the fitting room?
prompts.context: Shop assistant offering the fitting room
prompts.yourResponse: Sim, por favor. Onde é o provador?
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Yes, please. Where is the fitting room?

prompts.phrase: As promoções terminam este fim de semana.
prompts.english: The sale ends this weekend.
prompts.context: Shop assistant about the ongoing sale
prompts.yourResponse: Então aproveito e levo mais um.
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Then I'll take advantage and get another one.

prompts.phrase: Fazemos troca mas não fazemos reembolso.
prompts.english: We do exchanges but no refunds.
prompts.context: Shop assistant explaining the return policy
prompts.yourResponse: Está bem. Posso trocar na loja?
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: OK. Can I exchange it in the shop?

prompts.phrase: Este modelo está esgotado, mas posso encomendar para si.
prompts.english: This model is out of stock, but I can order it for you.
prompts.context: Shop assistant about stock levels
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: How long will it take to arrive?

prompts.phrase: O desconto já está aplicado no preço da etiqueta.
prompts.english: The discount is already applied to the tag price.
prompts.context: Shop assistant clarifying pricing
prompts.yourResponse: Ah, ótimo. Então fica em quanto?
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Oh, great. So how much is it?

prompts.phrase: Tem o talão de compra para fazer a troca?
prompts.english: Do you have the receipt to make the exchange?
prompts.context: Shop assistant asking for proof of purchase
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Yes, I have it here.

prompts.phrase: Os bilhetes para amanhã já estão esgotados.
prompts.english: Tomorrow's tickets are already sold out.
prompts.context: Box office staff about availability
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: And for the day after tomorrow?

prompts.phrase: Com o passe turístico tem desconto de vinte por cento.
prompts.english: With the tourist pass you get a twenty percent discount.
prompts.context: Ticket vendor about tourist pass benefits
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Yes, I do. Here it is.

prompts.phrase: A visita guiada começa daqui a meia hora.
prompts.english: The guided tour starts in half an hour.
prompts.context: Museum staff informing about a tour
prompts.yourResponse: Ótimo. Fazemos a visita livre e depois juntamo-nos.
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Great. We'll do the free visit and join the tour after.

prompts.phrase: Crianças com menos de doze anos não pagam entrada.
prompts.english: Children under twelve don't pay admission.
prompts.context: Ticket desk staff about children's entry
prompts.yourResponse: Perfeito. Somos dois adultos e uma criança de oito anos.
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Perfect. We're two adults and one child aged eight.

prompts.phrase: Pode reservar online e pagar aqui na bilheteira.
prompts.english: You can book online and pay here at the ticket office.
prompts.context: Staff explaining the booking process
prompts.yourResponse: Não tenho reserva. Há bilhetes para hoje?
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: I don't have a booking. Are there tickets for today?

prompts.phrase: O espetáculo de hoje está completo mas há lugares para quinta.
prompts.english: Today's show is full but there are seats for Thursday.
prompts.context: Box office staff about show availability
prompts.yourResponse: Então queria dois bilhetes para quinta-feira.
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Then I'd like two tickets for Thursday.

prompts.phrase: Tem receita médica para este medicamento?
prompts.english: Do you have a prescription for this medicine?
prompts.context: Pharmacist asking for a prescription
prompts.yourResponse: Não tenho. É possível comprar sem receita?
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: I don't have one. Is it possible to buy without a prescription?

prompts.phrase: Para a dor de cabeça, recomendo este analgésico.
prompts.english: For the headache, I recommend this painkiller.
prompts.context: Pharmacist making a recommendation
prompts.yourResponse: Tem algum mais suave? Tenho o estômago sensível.
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Do you have something milder? I have a sensitive stomach.

prompts.phrase: Tome um comprimido de oito em oito horas às refeições.
prompts.english: Take one tablet every eight hours with meals.
prompts.context: Pharmacist explaining dosage instructions
prompts.yourResponse: E posso tomar com outros medicamentos?
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: And can I take it with other medicines?

prompts.phrase: Este medicamento pode causar sonolência.
prompts.english: This medicine may cause drowsiness.
prompts.context: Pharmacist warning about side effects
prompts.yourResponse: Obrigado pelo aviso. Vou tomar só à noite.
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Thanks for the warning. I'll only take it at night.

prompts.phrase: Temos a versão genérica que é mais acessível.
prompts.english: We have the generic version which is more affordable.
prompts.context: Pharmacist suggesting a cheaper alternative
prompts.yourResponse: Qual é a diferença? O genérico funciona igual?
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: What's the difference? Does the generic work the same?

prompts.phrase: Com receita do SNS, paga apenas a comparticipação.
prompts.english: With an NHS prescription, you only pay the co-payment.
prompts.context: Pharmacist explaining the health service co-payment
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Great. Here's the prescription.

prompts.phrase: O que deseja?
prompts.english: What would you like?
prompts.context: Barista or staff asking for your order
prompts.yourResponse: Uma meia de leite, um pastel de nata e uma tosta mista, por favor.
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: A coffee with milk, a custard tart, and a ham and cheese toastie, please.

prompts.phrase: Quente ou morno?
prompts.english: Hot or warm?
prompts.context: Barista asking how you want your coffee temperature
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Nice and hot, please.

prompts.phrase: Mais alguma coisa?
prompts.english: Anything else?
prompts.context: Staff asking if you need anything more
prompts.yourResponse: Não, obrigado. Pode trazer a conta?
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: No, thanks. Can you bring the bill?

prompts.phrase: São quatro euros e cinquenta, por favor.
prompts.english: That's four euros fifty, please.
prompts.context: Staff telling you the total
prompts.yourResponseEnglish: Here you go. Thank you!
